issues.description: Dead private assertNumericNonNegative remains unused after the numeric-string price fix.
Timeout is a post-hoc elapsed check rather than preemptive cancellation; failure still produces a safe fallback.

concerns_addressed: Validator schema alignment with deterministic output confirmed fixed with low_confidence and numeric-string price plus a dedicated round-trip test
Listener leak and shared circuit state confirmed fixed with dispatcher clone/restore and Cache-backed breaker

strengths: Deterministic adapter output round-trips assertValid with a dedicated test
Write-detection listeners are scoped and restored, and the Cache-backed circuit breaker is shared across resolver instances
Read-only external contract and residual non-DB limitations are documented as an accepted MVP boundary per DD-4

issues.description: Circuit Cache get/forever read-modify-write is non-atomic under concurrency, so the failure threshold is approximate.
